authority: require_authoritative_domain ALWAYS UNAVAILABLE; no provider/storage sends
canonical: printable ASCII, sorted unique keys recursively, quote/backslash escapes only, no whitespace/BOM/newline/numeric literals/aliases; explicit null only where frozen schema permits

domains.digest: SHA256 complete exact canonical identity bytes; typed identity digest ONLY, not storage/publication root
domains.lineage: exchange/category/symbol/instrument_version exact tuple; markets and relisted incarnations never merged; allocator is external authority, parser does not assign incarnations
domains.scale: integer decimal string, no sign, no leading zero, no coercion

units.instrument_version: dimensionless positive u63 incarnation identifier, not a timestamp or schema version

domains.digest: SHA256 complete canonical CLAIM bytes only; never relabel as manifest/publication/root digest
domains.lineage: frozen V3 parser checks dataset/instrument/source/partition/content/evidence relationships; COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED has no dataset/instrument/partition lineage; claimed proof never actual authority
domains.scale: u63 decimal strings exact0..9223372036854775807, positive where frozen schema requires; UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ; no JSON numbers

units.*_ms: UTC Unix milliseconds for cursor/range; uncertainty fields are millisecond durations
units.committed_at_utc: required null UNKNOWN_COMMIT_INSTANT; observation is separate UTC millisecond precision
units.revisions_epochs_indices: distinct dimensionless u63 counters; domains never interchangeable

retention: identity retirement/unsubscription has no deletion effect; external approved A4 policy required
